definitions: To change (something) from religious to civil possession or use.
To make (something) more worldly or less religious.
To remove the religious character from (an institution, education, etc.).
examples: They plan to secularize the hospital.
The government sought to secularize public education.
Over time, many societies tend to secularize.
pastTenses: secularized (simple past), secularized (present perfect), secularized (past perfect)
